source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 1, 8. Δηλοῖ τὴν ἀνακοπὴν τῶν ἁμαρτημάτων τῆς Ἱερουσαλήμ, οὐκέτι τοῖς ἕμπροσθεν ἐπεκτεινομένης< τῶν πταισμάτων οὐδὲ ἐν τῇ τῶν ἁμαρτημάτων γινομένης, ἀλλ’ ἀποστρεφομένης εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω ἐπὶ τῶ ἰδίω καλῶ.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] It shows the cutting-short of Jerusalem’s sins—she no longer stretching forward unto the former stumbles nor coming to be in the advance of the sins, but turning away backward upon her own good.
pass_b_english: It shows the cutting-short of Jerusalem’s sins—she no longer stretching forward unto the former stumbles nor coming to be in the advance of the sins, but turning away backward upon her own good.

choices.why: Origen’s image of the fallen soul as storm-tossed in Lam 1:8 commentary.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.
